'''Mahtee Dunn''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the mother of a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] named [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]].

==Biography==
[[File:MahteeDunnHoldup-CotF.png|thumb|left|200px|Mahtee Dunn holds Obi-Wan Kenobi at blaster point]]
After obtaining the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], acting under the orders of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]], infiltrated Mahtee's home in [[Kay-Tap square/Legends|Kay-Tap square]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] to take Wee to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to further the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] plot against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Although Mahtee was hesitant to relinquish Wee, she was hypnotized by Bane and the child was taken from her. When a true [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], arrived in an attempt to stop Bane, Mahtee attempted to attack him, believing Bane's lie that Kenobi was a false Jedi out to kidnap her child. Although Kenobi pursued Bane to his [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|ship]], Wee was already on his way to Mustafar. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], working with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], were later able to deduce the location of the captured children and infiltrated Sidious' Mustafar base, rescuing Wee from the Sith's clutches and accepting him into the Jedi Order for the time being.<ref name="CotF">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mahtee was voiced by [[Jameelah McMillan]].<ref name="CotF" />
